tasks.label: lint
tasks.detail: Run ruff with the same rule set the N.E.K.O. market CI uses.
tasks.command: uvx ruff==0.12.4 check --ignore-noqa --isolated --target-version py311 --line-length 120 --select E4,E7,E9,F,I --exclude vendor .

tasks.label: check
tasks.detail: Run the pre-release check from the N.E.K.O. source tree.
tasks.command: uv run python -m plugin.neko_plugin_cli.cli check -r deepseekharness_bridge
